reconstruction.start_rule: first complete UTC day after persistent relevant-news inventory initialization
reconstruction.historical_classifier_policy: retain each published snapshot classification; never reclassify old headlines
reconstruction.missing_canonical_topic_policy: zero-fill canonical topics absent from an older snapshot
reconstruction.peak_tie_break: source_day_count descending, item_count descending, date ascending
reconstruction.prohibited_proxy: candidate_agenda_history.json is not used as media-volume history

denominator.item_formula: topic item_count / total classified Agenda items
denominator.source_day_formula: topic source_day_count / total Agenda topic source-days
denominator.note: Source-days are summed within topics; one publisher/date may contribute to different topic source-day totals through different single-label items.

labels.fr: Règles, calendrier et organisation de la campagne

historical_evidence.selection_rule: one observation per active canonical topic; matching daily source_snapshot_at; source_day_count descending, date ascending, published_at ascending, id ascending, url ascending; output date descending, published_at descending, id descending
